definitions.explanation: A country that is still in the process of industrialization and economic growth. A shortened form of 発展途上国.

examples.japanese: {途上国|とじょうこく}への{支援|しえん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Support for developing countries is needed.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{途上国|とじょうこく}では{清潔|せいけつ}な{水|みず}が{不足|ふそく}している。
examples.english: Many developing countries lack access to clean water.

examples.japanese: {先進国|せんしんこく}と{途上国|とじょうこく}の{経済|けいざい}{格差|かくさ}を{縮|ちぢ}めることが{国際|こくさい}{社会|しゃかい}の{課題|かだい}だ。
examples.english: Narrowing the economic gap between developed and developing countries is a challenge for the international community.

notes:
An abbreviation of {発展|はってん}{途上国|とじょうこく} (developing country). The full form literally means "country on the path of development" — {途上|とじょう} means "on the way" and {国|こく} means "country."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {途上国|とじょうこく}への{援助|えんじょ} (aid to developing countries)
- {途上国|とじょうこく}{支援|しえん} (support for developing countries)
- {先進国|せんしんこく}と{途上国|とじょうこく} (developed and developing countries)
- {途上国|とじょうこく}の{開発|かいはつ} (development of developing countries)

The shortened form {途上国|とじょうこく} is more common in everyday news and conversation than the full form {発展|はってん}{途上国|とじょうこく}. The opposite is {先進国|せんしんこく} (developed country).
